Admission Requirements

What you need to apply to AEU.

Application Guidelines

The AEU's academic programs and facilities are open to students of all Christian denominations who meet the standard requirements for admission. The AEU desires only qualified students and personnel who are committed to Jesus Christ. However, AEU does not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, national or ethnic origin in the administration of educational policies, admission policies, scholarships, or any other programs and activities.

Prerequisites

Students who apply for the Associate of Arts in Ministry Leadership (AAML) or the Bachelor of Ministry Leadership (BAML) programs must hold a high school diploma or its academic equivalent. Students who apply for a master's degree at the University must hold a four-year college degree (BA or its academic equivalent). No exception will be made for degree-seeking students. Students who desire to take a course by audit will not be subject to this prerequisite.

ProgramPrerequisite
Associate / Bachelor (AAML, BAML)High school diploma or equivalent
Master'sFour-year college degree (BA or equivalent)
AuditNot subject to prerequisite

Documents for Application

  • Application Form
  • Application FeeA non-refundable application fee, $100.
  • Two Letters of Recommendation
  • Statement of FaithA statement of the applicant's Christian faith.
  • Bachelor's Degree (Master's applicants)For master's-level degree programs: a completed accredited bachelor's degree.
  • One Recent Photograph
  • Sealed Official Transcript

How to Obtain Forms

The application form and other forms can be obtained from the AEU website, or by phone, fax, or email to the admissions office.

  • America Evangelical University1204 W 163rd St, Gardena, CA 90247
  • Emailinfo@aeu.edu
  • Tel / FaxTel) 323-643-0301 · Fax) 323-643-0302

Application Deadlines

Every year, the deadline for Spring application is around January 15, and for Fall application is August 15. For foreign students, check the academic calendar.

TermDeadline
Spring SemesterAround January 15
Fall SemesterAround August 15
